## Design

### 2026-10-07 – 7th of October  START : 1:30 PM

**5.1h**

7th of October  START : 1:30 PM
today, I got KiCad Installed and downloaded the Week 1 started Package to prepare for designing the PCB. I watched a video on how use KiCad before to have some basic knowledge on the program. at 2PM I imported the Symbols and Footprints to start laying out my schematic.

![image_2026-10-07_174757325](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/03b66b2fe368ef58ba80ec0bdffc2d8542950d164bbad18d7eae154cb598c12b.png)

then I ran a ERC/Electrical Rules Checker and it came with 3 errors in the image below and tomorrow I will use google to see where or how to fix this.

![image_2026-10-07_174927726](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/50ec2254021cb576f38dee52e63c6883f8334597694cfb13f6775344d866e737.png)

I started laying out the PCB schematic, got stuck at some parts but found the solutions pretty quickly which was great. I converted the schematic to the PCB Designer, then placed them using a GitHub reference image for this project, then when I had the components in the place I drew the star shape around the parts I have to admit the shape is kinda bad but it looks like a star so its fine.

![image_2026-10-07_175121869](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/a30adcb5328d49d4082a3d22c41e26b3493d18a937f638ef917668628a3c3565.png)

Then I started to do the routing of the PCB which was easier than I thought it would be, then made a ground infill zone for the GND ports.

![image_2026-10-07_175226137](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/e4f27350116f24308c12a4b32b4e153312159525baa3033307c46785b00cdc1d.png) ![image_2026-10-07_175402110](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/18f032b28c1c39b9e45ec000dd2c8c22d47405274ad21f551d0a1976296c6e5e.png)

then I ran a DRC check which gave 2 errors like what the GitHub documentation.

![image_2026-10-07_175513888](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/0074a36ebd49cd124a1300e615e3d786edc635f6c9ce940c9cee74d784b821e0.png)

Then for next day that I work on this I will dive deeper into fixing all my errors that I have gotten today.

### 2026-10-10 – Today I started by working on fixing the the design errors in the Design Rule Checker which was to do with the Oled screens Footprint, i searched around google for where and what I'd need to change to

**4.5h**

Today I started by working on fixing the the design errors in the Design Rule Checker which was to do with the Oled screens Footprint, i searched around google for where and what I'd need to change to fix this error and it brought me to a Footprint editor and i started by deleting the old courtyard shape which is the Purple box and i drew a new rectangle, Saved the Footprint then ran another Design Rule Check to having 0 errors (as shown in the screenshots below.) which was great.

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 150805](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/8acecca8be1dcea06c2266abe336b2833785a7001ccf541506387055962fa5ad.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-10 150903](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/bb5baf23d215bf6be3b6fbcc712d23e262dfc03027e6f657ef669ade3c4d9989.png)

Then when looking at the reference image in the GitHub repository for the Starbie project I saw that my trace lines were a lot thinner so I decent to increase the thickness by a 0.1mm which made it look closer to the image.
![image_2026-10-10_174035814](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/caoycXV5BNN4q492uKwtItFI7vH3U2nD/e952c9a9ce2ac87c121b4a8f796621f693c0e69f75f1d144bd38a3aaa36478ba.png)
